title: 湖亭焚香，石壁旧歌

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization

source_grounding.anchor_after: 眼前湖水澄清，月轮荡漾，湖边小亭，有一缕焚香，袅袅而上。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 拓拔野循箫声越过竹篱和亭阁，却只见湖边小亭、袅袅焚香和空无一人的月下湖岸。他在亭中看到白色玛瑙香炉与紫烟，又发现北侧高石壁上有巨大凸起文字，认出那正是神农昨日唱过的歌，心中悲喜交错，取下绿竹笛吹起同一曲调。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 拓拔野吹笛后，身后箫声应和，转身误以为神农，却见白衣女子出现。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, relic bundle, green bamboo flute at waist or in hand, Wufeng in a bamboo sheath at the right waist.
White dragon-deer remains a friendly mythic mount and emotional companion, staying near Tuobaye without comic exaggeration.
The lake pavilion is simple and handmade: bamboo, pine logs, stone table, white agate incense burner, faint purple incense smoke, moonlit lake water.
Stone-wall text is a story beat but image/video must not generate readable characters. Show raised, ancient, indistinct glyph-like relief or blurred large strokes instead of legible writing.
Do not reveal the white-clothed woman yet until the final hook or next segment; this segment may end on the off-screen response of the flute/xiao sound.
Emotional arc: mystery, disappointment, recognition of 神农's song, quiet grief, then musical response.
localization_rules: All planning text and eventual editing dialogue should be Chinese unless a technical field requires English.
Storyboard prompts may describe Chinese short-drama style, but must request no readable screen text.
I2V prompts must use silent visual generation: no synthesized speech, no captions, no subtitles, no readable signs, no English words.
Chinese narration, flute/xiao sound design, and subtitles should be added later in editing.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: experimental_file_ids only while current local backend supports it; otherwise use official T2V smoke tests or switch provider for formal I2V
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Prefer stable camera, incense smoke, water shimmer, slow reaction shots, and flute-playing pose; avoid complex performance animation.
